judgement.reason: WeKan needs a MongoDB wire-protocol database (external MongoDB, or bundled FerretDB on local SQLite disk), which Deployz does not provide, unless FerretDB can run with the managed PostgreSQL.

evidence.quote: #   WEKAN_DB=mongodb   -> never start FerretDB; use external MONGO_URL (a mongod
#   WEKAN_DB=ferretdb  -> start the bundled FerretDB (SQLite) on 127.0.0.1:27017
- FerretDB v1 with PostgreSQL works; with MySQL, MariaDB or SAP HANA it is
